quarterly_data.quarter: Astera Labs press release: Astera Labs Unveils Orion: A Compute-Agnostic Rack-Scale (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Astera Labs announced Orion, a modular, compute-agnostic rack-scale reference architecture: six production-grade reference designs (rack, compute tray, fabric tray, memory tray, link board and compute board) integrated with its COSMOS Rack Manager and COSMOS Fabric Manager software, built on a high-radix 320-lane PCIe switch fabric designed to scale from 8 to 160 GPUs per pod, letting customers choose their own GPUs and CPUs via PCIe plug-in cards. Astera Labs will not manufacture the racks: complete racks and individual systems are to be manufactured, licensed and sold through its OEM and ODM partners, with Orion rack reference and system designs on track for availability through those partners beginning in Q1 2027. Target customers are primarily neoclouds and enterprises building AI inference capacity. The company plans to extend Orion's roadmap to additional open interconnects, including UALink.
quarterly_data.figure: 320-lane PCIe switch fabric; 8 to 160 GPUs per pod; availability through OEM/ODM partners beginning Q1 2027
